name: get_project
description: Summarise the open OpenComp project: composition settings, tracks (top track is the top layer), clips with ids/times/type/effects/masks/animated properties, imported media assets, markers, work area and the playhead. Call this first to learn ids before editing. Times are in seconds. Positions are in composition pixels, as offsets from the frame centre.

name: get_frame
description: Render the composition (with all effects, masks and grading) at a time and return it as an image, so you can see what the edit looks like. Use it to check your work.

time.description: Timeline time in seconds. Defaults to the playhead.

max_size.description: Longest side of the returned image in pixels (default 768).

name: list_effects
description: List every effect that can be added to a clip, with each parameter's key, type, range and default, plus the animation presets.

name: seek
description: Move the playhead to a time.

name: import_media
description: Import video/audio/image files into the project by absolute path. Desktop app only.

name: add_media_clip
description: Put an imported asset on the timeline. Returns the new clip id.

track_id.description: Preferred track; a free track is used if it is occupied.

name: add_text
description: Add a text layer (title, caption, lower third) on a new top track. Returns the clip id.

x.description: Horizontal offset from the frame centre, in comp px.

y.description: Vertical offset from the frame centre, in comp px (positive is down).

box.description: Draw a background box behind the text.

name: add_solid
description: Add a full-frame solid colour layer on a new top track. Returns the clip id.

name: add_adjustment_layer
description: Add an adjustment layer: its colour grade, effects and masks apply to every layer below it. Returns the clip id.

name: update_clip
description: Change a clip. Only the fields you pass change. transform: {x, y, scale (%), rotation (deg), opacity (%)}. color: {exposure (stops, -3..3), contrast, highlights, shadows, saturation, temperature, tint (each -100..100)}. audio: {volume (%), pan (-100..100), fadeIn, fadeOut (s), low, mid, high (dB)}. text: any text style field. If a property is animated (has keyframes), use set_keyframe instead.

name: split_clip
description: Cut clips in two at a time. Cuts the given clip, or every clip under that time if no clip_id is given.

name: delete_clip
description: Delete a clip. With ripple, later clips on the same track move back to close the gap.

name: add_effect
description: Add an effect to a clip (see list_effects for types and parameters). Returns the effect id.

params.description: Parameter values by key; omitted ones use defaults.

name: update_effect
description: Change an effect's parameters or switch it on/off.

name: remove_effect
description: Remove an effect from a clip.

name: set_keyframe
description: Animate a numeric property by setting its value at a timeline time. Property paths: transform.x, transform.y, transform.scale, transform.rotation, transform.opacity, color.<key>, audio.volume, audio.pan, text.size, fx.<effect_id>.<param>. Add two or more keyframes to animate.

name: apply_preset
description: Apply an animation preset (adds keyframes): fade-in, fade-out, slide-left, slide-right, slide-up, slide-down, pop-in, spin-in, ken-burns-in, ken-burns-out, drift, shake, blur-in.

name: add_marker
description: Add a bookmark marker on the timeline.

name: remove_marker
description: Remove a marker.

name: set_composition
description: Change the project name, resolution, frame rate or background colour.

name: set_work_area
description: Limit playback and export to a time range. Pass no start/end to clear it.

name: ai_mask
description: Mask an object in a video or image clip using AI segmentation. Give points in composition pixels (as seen in get_frame at full resolution, origin top-left) on or off the object at the given time. Returns the mask id. Hides everything outside the object; set inverted with update_mask to remove the object instead.

name: update_mask
description: Change a mask: mode (add/subtract/intersect), inverted, feather (px), expansion (px), opacity (%), enabled.

name: track_mask
description: Track an AI mask's object through the clip so the mask follows it. Can take a while.

name: generate_captions
description: Transcribe the speech in a clip (or every clip with audio) into caption text layers on a new Captions track. Can take a while.

name: add_track
description: Add an empty track at the top.

name: undo
description: Undo the last change.

name: redo
description: Redo the last undone change.
